narrative.details:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
narrative.objectives: Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, Harten.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.
